note.text: A console cable manages the switch; it never carries the network's data. That is why it can reach a switch that has no address at all.

lesson.title: Manage it through the console port
lesson.goal: The new switch is set right through its console and Desk0 reaches ClosetServer

step.text: Ping ClosetServer (192.168.8.2) from Desk0 and watch it fail: the new switch left the desk's port in VLAN 20, away from everyone else.
The switch has no address, so the network cannot reach it. Run a console cable from AdminLaptop to Switch0.
Open the laptop's terminal: the console drops you on the switch. Name it: configure terminal, then hostname Closet1.
Bring the port home: interface Fa0/1, then switchport access vlan 1.

check.label: The desk's port is back in VLAN 1
